_comment: DemoOverlay — ADR-14 / PRD F-TIME-01. Checked BEFORE DuckDB; dates are expressed as
offsets from asOf, so a persona stays current under any AS_OF_DATE instead of rotting
the way an absolute date would.
This file is deliberately SMALL. Every other demo case comes from real fixture rows —
an overlay persona that duplicates data the database already has replaces grounded
evidence with invented evidence, which is the opposite of what this system is for.
The one gap it fills is real and was measured: no user's CURRENT membership is a live
trial. Every trial in the fixture either converted (leaving a paid row behind it) or
expired on or before the order anchor, so after the uniform shift the newest current
trial ended yesterday. SAD 4, consequence 2 predicted exactly this case.
The persona sits on a REAL user id, so get_user and the order history still resolve
against the database. Only the membership row is overlaid, and the turn reports
overlayHit=true so an operator can see it happened.
